title: Route Intent Planner
user: Cyclists and ride leaders who know the roads or paths they intend to use and need a route planner that preserves those choices instead of silently redrawing them.
smallest_useful_product: A GPX/web planner that accepts a rough trace or named mandatory segments, locks those corridors, optimizes only gaps, and flags off-intent sections.
success_measure: At least 85% of routes made by ride leaders need no post-export correction to preserve their selected roads/paths.
constraints: Use OpenStreetMap-compatible data/licensing; clearly label routing as advisory; cache map data and respect tile-provider policy.
